dish: A flight in the two-story-windowed taproom (free Friday concerts in summer)
w: Verona production brewery whose pond-side taproom a fellow brewer called 'the most state-of-the-art new brewery in Wisconsin' (Isthmus); featured in Experience Wisconsin's craft tap-room guide.

dish: Tacos on handmade tortillas, huaraches and sopes
w: Park Street's real taquería — handmade tortillas, a steamy counter and a back patio; Isthmus readers' Mad Faves Mexican pick, reviewed by Isthmus, the Cap Times and the Daily Cardinal ('Madison favorite').

dish: A Spotted Cow at the 1893 back bar, with a brat or Swiss cheese plate
w: New Glarus' 1893 tavern, its bar, floors, walls and ceiling 'like they were 110 years ago' — OnMilwaukee's New Glarus pick; Travel Wisconsin-listed.

dish: Saturday Norwegian meatballs with lingonberry, or Norwegian salmon with dill hollandaise
w: Stoughton brewpub (2014; in-house brewing since 2015) leaning into the town's Norwegian heritage — a Nordic fishing-boat bar and Norwegian plates; Isthmus covered its opening.
